Subject: DPA redlines and audit evidence request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the call earlier. Attached are our redlines to Redwood's standard DPA (Stellaris_DPA_redlines_v3.docx). Two quick asks up front while legal reviews:

- Can you provide the up-to-date subprocessors list and a point of contact for vendor questions?
- We need copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II or, if that's not public, a downloadable report or a link to a secure location.
- Please provide a pen-test executive summary (we don't need raw findings — redacted/summaries are fine).
- Regarding audit rights: our standard requires the ability to perform an onsite or third-party audit upon 14 days' notice. Is that acceptable?

We'd like to get this DPA in DocuSign next week if possible. Procurement is looped for timeline questions.

Thanks,
Claire Han
Legal Counsel
Stellaris Health

Subject: Re: DPA redlines and audit evidence request

Hi Claire — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks.

Quick responses:
- Subprocessors: attaching our current list (redwood_subprocessors_20260612.csv). It includes infra/cloud partners, logging providers, and metrics/analytics vendors.
- SOC 2: our most recent Type II report is available. I'm linking a secure copy below and attaching our public certificate.
- Pen test: attached is an executive summary of our most recent external penetration test (pen_test_exec_summary_redwood_2026.pdf). We redact customer-identifying details for safety.
- Audit rights: we typically accept third-party audits with reasonable scope and notice. A few points to propose for compromise — see below.

Proposed items to discuss before we sign:
1) Audit window: 30 days' notice for any third-party audit (we have operational dependencies to coordinate).
2) Scope limitation: audits limited to systems and controls that process Stellaris data; no access to other customers' environments or raw customer content.
3) Redaction and confidentiality: Redwood will deliver redacted reports or accompany auditors with a Redwood security lead present.
4) Cost allocation: if the audit is initiated by Stellaris and is more than annual or outside scope, we'd ask you to cover reasonable third-party costs.

If those look reasonable we can accept a redline that reflects them and then send the DPA into DocuSign. Happy to do a 30 min call with your counsel to go through items. Proposed times: Mon 6/15 or Tue 6/16 PST.

Links: SOC2 report (secure copy): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-public-compliance/soc2-2025.pdf
DocuSign placeholder: https://docusign.com/reddoc/abcd-1234

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Kimberly — thanks for the quick follow-up and for the materials. A couple of clarifications from our side after initial review:

- The SOC 2 link works; good.
- For the pen-test exec summary, our security team still wants to understand whether critical/high findings were remediated and within what timeframe. Redaction is fine but we need remediation dates and whether there were any open high-severity items at time of sign-off.
- Regarding subprocessors: one of the named vendors is a managed logging provider. We need confirmation they have access controls that prevent cross-customer log access.
- Audit rights: we appreciate your proposal. Our standard is 14 days notice and the ability to use an independent auditor. If you require 30 days, can we compromise on 21 days and allow a 3rd-party auditor of our choosing under an NDA?

Also attached is a short questionnaire (audit_questionnaire_stellaris.pdf) with a handful of SOC mappings — could you have your security team fill this out?

Claire Han
Legal Counsel
Stellaris Health

Hi Claire (and Stellaris team),

Thanks for the patience. We pulled together the items below so you can proceed to final review:

1) Subprocessors: attached file (redwood_subprocessors_20260612.csv) — includes brief notes on access model for each vendor. For the managed logging provider we note that the vendor enforces per-customer indices and RBAC — no cross-customer log access.

2) Pen test remediation summary: attached pen_test_exec_summary_redwood_2026.pdf. Executive summary includes remediation dates for the two high/critical findings from Q1 2026. Both were closed within 45 days of discovery; remediation timelines are documented. If you want additional evidence we can provide sanitized remediation tickets under an NDA.

3) SOC2: link and certificate attached.

4) Questionnaire: completed and attached (see attached).

5) Audit clause — proposed compromise redline language (summary):
   - Third-party audit permitted subject to NDA.
   - 21 days' prior written notice required.
   - Scope limited to systems and controls processing Stellaris data; no access to raw customer content from other customers.
   - Redwood security lead will accompany the auditor and Redwood will deliver redacted artifacts as appropriate.
   - If Stellaris initiates an audit outside the agreed cadence or on an expedited basis, Stellaris will be responsible for reasonable third-party audit costs.

If that language looks acceptable we will send the final DPA into DocuSign (Redwood to initiate). We plan to lock deployment of the DPA in DocuSign with a 5 business day review window for Stellaris. Please confirm by EOD Friday 6/19 so Procurement can schedule signature.

Next steps:
- Kimberly to initiate DocuSign envelope with the DPA redline (Redwood will be first signer).
- Stellaris to confirm final acceptance or provide one last narrow redline.
- Once executed, we will provide a compliance package (SOC2 cert, pen-test exec summary, subprocessors CSV) via a secure link and retain proof of execution in our contract repository.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a short call if you prefer to close quickly.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
